native_correlations.proof: _cmd_drop gates exact 'You may not drop that item!' path
_sell_item expands item Cost into native denomination conversion

canonical_item_catalog.ordered_ability_requirement: abilities_named is an ordered slot list; repeated ability_id values are valid and must not be collapsed

drop.failure: You may not drop that item!

appraise.mutation: appraise flag does not remove inventory or add shop stock
appraise.price_formula: same _sell_item value path as SELL; Charm factor floor(Charm/2)+25 over 100
appraise.currency_owner: converted native sell value is rendered as copper farthing(s)

native_charge_contract.zero_behavior: A successful use decrements the signed int16 current Uses first. At transition to exactly zero, retain iff RetainAfterUses is nonzero; otherwise clear the copy. A retained zero-use copy is not the -1 sentinel, so its next successful use decrements 0 to -1 and becomes unlimited.
native_charge_contract.equipment_behavior: native zero-use removal traverses equipment cleanup before/with slot clearing
native_charge_contract.unlimited_rule: Only the current per-copy value -1 bypasses decrement; other signed values are processed normally.

shop_sell_appraise_contract.eligibility: item id must match one of the shop's 20 merchandise entries
shop_sell_appraise_contract.stock_behavior: current stock increments only while below max on SELL; APPRAISE never mutates stock; full stock does not invalidate the merchandise match
shop_sell_appraise_contract.gang_shop: ShopType 11 rejects sell/appraise with 'You may not sell items to a gang shop.'

delegated_exact_owners.room_item_slots_and_unlimited_room_stack: Character death/room placement native pass (17 visible, 15 hidden; unlimited-use room QTY stacking)

reforged_extensions_excluded_from_classi: generic portable nested-container ownership and depth rules

native_use_no_target_contract.casts_sp: Ability 43 resolves the spell, invokes the native cast helper, and returns immediately with that helper boolean; later CastsSp slots are not executed by the same no-target use.
native_use_no_target_contract.percent_spell: Ability 114 stops ordinary no-target scanning unless caller mode is 11.
native_use_no_target_contract.food_drink_corpus: Canonical food/drink records use CastsSp plus unrelated maintenance/magical flags; no-effect drink item.1608 follows the fallback-counter path.

eat_drink_fallback_contract.slow_update: both words decrement once in the native 30-fast-tick slow character update
eat_drink_fallback_contract.no_effect: success text is already emitted; counter increments by one; item Uses is not deducted
eat_drink_fallback_contract.naming_boundary: Neutral runtime marker names are retained because the public 1.11o+ field map does not authoritatively name these two words.
